value.body: Scientific assistants support scientists in government laboratories: running experiments and instruments, collecting and analysing samples, maintaining records and equipment. Employers include forensic science labs, the India Meteorological Department, Department of Atomic Energy units and other research and testing labs. Posts are usually Group B or C.

items.label: Typical eligibility
items.value: B.Sc in a specified subject (sometimes M.Sc or diploma)
items.note: Each notice names the exact subjects

items.label: Common recruiters
items.value: SSC, DAE units, state PSCs / forensic labs

items.label: Pay level (IMD Scientific Assistant)
items.note: Group B post in the India Meteorological Department; recruited through this SSC exam in 2026
items.source: SSC Junior Engineer Examination 2026 notice (as reported)

items.label: IMD Scientific Assistant posts (2022 notice)
items.note: Vacancies vary a lot from one notice to the next
items.source: SSC Scientific Assistant (IMD) Examination 2022 notice (as reported)

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Hold a science degree in the subjects named for the post (for example physics, chemistry or forensic science). Central posts come through SSC exams (including Selection Posts and IMD scientific assistant recruitment), DAE units' own trainee schemes for B.Sc graduates, and state PSC or department notices for forensic and state labs. Selection is usually a written test, sometimes with a skill test or interview.

value.title: At a glance
items: Subject wording is strict — similar coursework may not count if the degree name doesn't match.
Openings are scattered across many employers, so tracking multiple notices helps.
The work is lab-based, often with shift or field duties (for example in weather or forensic work).

value.title: IMD Scientific Assistant (2022 exam) — candidates shortlisted by category
value.note: 995 candidates provisionally shortlisted; reserved-category candidates who qualified at the unreserved standard are counted under Unreserved. One exam only.
